WF-03 Step 0.5 — registry lookup and GitHub filing for ISS-0123 / GitHub #389.

1. Call fn:search-issues. Read docs/issues/ISS-0123.json (already exists). Confirm it covers the issue referenced by the user (audit P0001 + source_ref C42703). Also read docs/issues/ISS-0124.json, ISS-0125.json, ISS-0126.json for recent resolution patterns (C42883 type-cast fix, CASCADE FK fix, schema-qualified pg_constraint fix) — these are recent adjacent fixes that may inform the approach.

2. Refine docs/issues/ISS-0123.json:

   - Set/refresh the last_seen_at field to current timestamp if missing

3. GitHub filing: GitHub issue #389 already exists in the repo (tvolodi/R-Co#389) — confirmed by gh CLI. This is the SAME issue as ISS-0123. Cross-reference: ensure docs/issues/ISS-0123.json has github_issue set to https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/389 (already there per the file content). Do NOT file a duplicate GitHub issue.

4. Add cross-reference comment to GitHub #389 if it does not already link to a tracking comment for this WF-03 run. Use: gh issue comment 389 --repo tvolodi/R-Co --body "<!-- rco-sync-ref: ISS-0123 -->\nWF-03 fix in progress on branch feature/WF03-gh389-20260802.". If a previous comment with this tag already exists, do not duplicate.

5. Verify: docs/issues/ISS-0123.json exists, contains github_issue field, status remains OPEN (resolution not yet applied).

Return PASS only after the issue file is current and the GitHub comment is in place. Do NOT diagnose root cause or implement a fix — those are Steps 1 and 3 respectively.
